purpose: Structured tool-call qualification for reasoning-aware grammar activation in the Infernal Invocation r9 DeepSeek-V4-Flash-0731 runtime

source_contract.invariant: A grammar supplied by the reasoning parser is active from token zero so an unconstrained reasoning prefix cannot consume a complete tool block before the structural grammar requires another one.

conclusion: All buffered and streaming responses emitted exactly one valid tool call for auto, required, and named tool selection. The reasoning-aware structural grammar no longer permits duplicate tool calls when parallel_tool_calls is omitted.
